# Plumberry

Plumberry is a pale pink-lilac Pegasus filly with a dark indigo-purple mane and violet eyes. She is easiest to recognize among the youngsters Rarity entertains at Sweetie Belle’s birthday party, shown in a dream flashback—not as a major speaking character.

**Name and voice.** “Plumberry” is the identifying name in the [G4 foal catalogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals), which also records her appearances. A wiki identification still uses the name for S4E19, but I found no verified spoken name, Hasbro naming credit, or merchandise confirmation: treat it as a *fandom/identification name*, not an established official name. No individual spoken line or credited voice actor is verified. The speaking birthday-party colt *Plum Star* is a different character.

**Appearances.** *For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils* (S4E19; dream flashback), *Inspiration Manifestation* (S4E23), *Make New Friends but Keep Discord* (S5E7), *Party Pooped* (S5E11), and the 2019 animated short *Sundae, Sundae, Sundae*. These are background appearances; no independent television story arc is verified.

**Separate fan-fiction continuity.** In [Fluttercheer’s March 2018 introduction](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/803264/introducing-plumberry), Plumberry is Brown Sugar’s opinionated second friend. That friendship, personality and family background are the author’s fan-fiction characterization—not established television facts.

## Important moments

1. **Rarity wins over the birthday guests — *For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils* (S4E19).** Plumberry is among the foals at Sweetie Belle’s fifth-birthday celebration, where Rarity’s attention to the guests contributes to Sweetie’s jealousy. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NTuwXjwxfJQ); **scene timestamp unavailable** (not independently verified).
2. **Back in present-day Ponyville — *Inspiration Manifestation* (S4E23).** Her background return during the episode about Rarity’s enchanted creativity distinguishes her from a pony who appears only in Sweetie Belle’s dream. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OwqpPPcIC4Y); **scene timestamp unavailable** (not independently verified).

Plumberry has no verified character-defining speech or individual decision in these scenes; they are her clearest identification moments.
